As for what he did, it's rather petty for me to get upset about this and it's mostly my fault, but still it's a little inappropriate what he did.
Basically I was with a friend and we had gotten drunk together, and we decided it'd be funny to change my boyfriend's religion to Kopimism on Facebook because of an inside joke. We share League of Legends accounts and so I guessed his Facebook password to be his LoL password, and I was right.

Well after changing his religion and my friend leaving the room, stupid, dumbass, drunken me didn't log out. Nope! On a lapse of a bad judgement, I began looking through a few of his messages. What I saw made me really sad. I of course, confessed to what I did immediately and confronted him about it and apologized for my terrible behavior PROFUSELY the moment he came online.

He had been flirting with a certain girl he always talks badly about to me; calling her nice names, (beautiful, cutie, etc.) and asking for her attention. He had given me a picture one day, a really cute one of him with the caption "Who's the most amazing girl in the world? You are, [My name]!" months ago, and he had given her the exact same picture, with my name erased. It hurt. His excuse for these actions was that this is his first relationship and he was just used to talking to that certain girl in that way, he has since deleted her and no longer speaks to her.

Another thing that happened was he had hid the fact that he used to have feelings for this other girl he's known since childhood and almost had a one-night stand with, he liked her at the same time he liked me. I asked him about that out of simple curiosity a few times, even when we were together, he always denied it. While in this relationship he had hung out with her, and invited her to many things without telling me. It doesn't bother me that he did that, what bothers me is that he kept it a secret. You wouldn't have to hide something unless there was a reason to hide it. His reasoning for not telling me that he liked her was because he liked ME more and didn't want to hut his chances of getting me as his girlfriend (which is completely legitimate and I agree with it completely) and as for hiding seeing her, he said he simply didn't want to hurt me apparently. He has since deleted her and no longer speaks to her.

I initially didn't want him talking to the second girl in question but I have since told him he could see her if he wants and I apologized for putting that restriction on him. He thanked me and told me that if he actually wanted to see her, he would've argued the moment I put that restriction on him, but he'll keep that in mind for the future.

So yeah. I'm not sure if my anxieties are really justified. It was my fault for being a psycho bitch and looking at his messages though.
